summary:
Fixed the schema drift bug in [app/main.go](/workspace/app/main.go:108): create and fetch now use `order_status` instead of the renamed-away `status` column. I also rebuilt `/workspace/orders-api` so the provided harness runs the patched code.

Verification: `PATH=/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin:$PATH ./test.sh` passes with `ALL TESTS PASSED`.

Note: running plain `./test.sh` initially failed because `initdb` exists under `/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin` but that directory is not on the default `PATH` in this environment.
